summary: BioMar completed an acquisition of a Chilean aquaculture farmer, significantly boosting the financial performance of its parent company Schouw & Co. The deal resulted in a doubling of Schouw's cashflow.
title: BioMar buys Chilean farmer, Schouw & Co. cashflow doubles
title_en: BioMar buys Chilean farmer, Schouw & Co. cashflow doubles

summary: A Marine Harvest Chile farm site (Quitralco 6) has been recognized as BioMar Farmer of the Year, highlighting productive results achieved with BioMar feed. The article indicates strong performance outcomes from the use of BioMar aquaculture feed at the facility.
title: Resultados productivos en Quitralco 6: "Biomar Farmer of the Year en Marine Harvest Chile"
title_en: Resultados productivos en Quitralco 6: "Biomar Farmer of the Year en Marine Harvest Chile"
